parameters.query:
-- Customers with 1-2 orders whose last pack runs out in 3 days and who opted in to WhatsApp.
-- contacts(user_id, phone_e164, first_name, whatsapp_opt_in) is your consent table.
WITH last AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.user_id) o.user_id, o.order_time, i.product_id
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING (order_id)
  ORDER BY o.user_id, o.order_time DESC, i.price DESC
), n AS (SELECT user_id, count(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.user_id, c.phone_e164, c.first_name, p.product_id, n.orders
FROM last l
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
JOIN n USING (user_id)
JOIN contacts c USING (user_id)
WHERE n.orders BETWEEN 1 AND 2
  AND c.whatsapp_opt_in
  AND (l.order_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date + p.cycle_days - 3 = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sends s WHERE s.user_id = l.user_id AND s.campaign = 'replenishment_reminder'
                  AND s.send_time > now() - interval '20 days');
